description.summary: This table defines terms used in claim clarification and settlement rules for Harel Insurance Company Ltd. It is used to look up the meaning of terms related to claims processing.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מגדירה מונחים המשמשים בכללי הבהרת תביעות והסדרים עבור חברת הביטוח הראל. המונחים מוגדרים לצורך יישום הכללים על סוגי ביטוח שונים, כגון ביטוח פנסיה, ביטוח חיים וביטוח תאונות אישיות. ניתן למצוא כאן הגדרות למונחים כמו 'יום/ימים', 'תביעה', 'תובע', 'מומחה', 'קשיש' ו'לקוח'. ההגדרות מסייעות בהבנת התנאים וההליכים הקשורים לטיפול בתביעות בחברת הראל. המונחים 'יום/ימים', 'תביעה', 'תובע', 'מומחה', 'קשיש' ו'לקוח' מוגדרים בטבלה זו.
notable_values: Day/ days: business days excluding Fridays, Saturdays, Holiday eves, Jewish and public holidays.
Claim: a demand from Harel for realization of rights in accordance with the insurance policy conditions.
Plaintiff: anyone who fles a claim against Harel, except for an institutional entity.
Expert: whether or not an employee of Harel and whether or not he/she met with the plaintiff.
Senior citizen: a person over the age of 67.
Client: an insured, member, benefciary, plaintiff or whomsoever on their behalf.

In this set of rules, the following terms shall have the following defnitions:
Day/ days - business days excluding Fridays, Saturdays, Holiday eves, Jewish and public holidays.
Claim - a demand from Harel for realization of rights in accordance with the insurance policy conditions, pension fund regulations or the relevant provisions of law regarding realization of rights as aforementioned.
Plaintiff - anyone who fles a claim against Harel, except for an institutional entity and except for anyone who, in the framework of his/her occupation, provides compensation for damage sustained by another and fles a claim against Harel to collect the compensation paid as aforementioned.
Expert - whether or not an employee of Harel and whether or not he/she met with the plaintiff, such as a surveyor or medical expert, however, excluding legal counsel and except for a pension fund medical committee operating by virtue of the articles.
Senior citizen - a person over the age of 67.
Client - an insured, member, benefciary, plaintiff or whomsoever on their behalf.

טבלה: הגדרות
This table defines terms used in claim clarification and settlement rules for Harel Insurance Company Ltd. It is used to look up the meaning of terms related to claims processing.
ממדים: term, definition

A. DHfniWions
In this set of rules, the following terms shall have the following defnitions:
Day/ days - business days excluding Fridays, Saturdays, Holiday eves, Jewish and public holidays.
Claim - a demand from Harel for realization of rights in accordance with the insurance policy conditions, pension fund regulations or the relevant provisions of law regarding realization of rights as aforementioned.
Plaintiff - anyone who fles a claim against Harel, except for an institutional entity and except for anyone who, in the framework of his/her occupation, provides compensation for damage sustained by another and fles a claim against Harel to collect the compensation paid as aforementioned.
Expert - whether or not an employee of Harel and whether or not he/she met with the plaintiff, such as a surveyor or medical expert, however, excluding legal counsel and except for a pension fund medical committee operating by virtue of the articles.
Senior citizen - a person over the age of 67.
Client - an insured, member, benefciary, plaintiff or whomsoever on their behalf.
